li.description: A small handwoven rug: either a photo of a real antique carpet or a drawn design in the same weaving traditions (city medallion, prayer, Herat vine and palmette, garden, boteh, vase, Heriz, Turkmen, Qashqai kilim, Gabbeh, kilim or Baluch).
